source_segments.text: a subdivisional town under the 10th Act of Municipal Rules.
The Municipality of Katwa as a governing entity was established on 1 April 1869.

The urbanization of Katwa received a further boost with the construction of railroads in the early 20th century: Katwa-Azimganj (constructed in 1903), Katwa-Bandel (1912), Katwa-Bardhaman (1915), Katwa-Ahmedpur (1917).
As per the 2011 Census of India Katwa had a total population of 81,615, of which 41,350 (51%) were males and 40,265 (49%) were females.
The total number of literates in Katwa was 65,187 (79.87% of the population over 6 years).
